$comment: Coverage thresholds for orchestrator agents and CI. Portable across projects — adjust values per-repo.

enforcement.command: bash -c 'shopt -s nullglob; for f in tests/*/test-*.sh; do echo "== $f"; bash "$f" || exit 1; done' && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 --test-coverage-include=bin/metaswarm-usage tests/lib/metaswarm-usage.test.mjs && node lib/sync-resources.js --check
enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds before marking any task complete or creating a PR. If coverage drops below any threshold, the task fails.
